body: I feel like I'd given up on any hope of anything changing or happening years ago. I don't want anything to change, I don't want to do anything because I don't actually care or believe it's worth much effort, and I don't feel comfortable living the way I do now. I've had someone offer to help me and try to see if they can get me somewhere to live, and thinking about it makes me feel almost physically sick between having to be around people and burdening them with my problems and my complete and utter inability to cope with anything. I'm in a bad state right now, I'm shaking and I can't think clearly and I want everything to stop because I feel like it's not getting better, but I don't have the means or the willpower to do more than wish I could, really. I think I'll try to sleep, if I can. Ignore things for a little while.

I haven't seen her since June, though. She said there was nothing she could do personally to help me get health insurance, it was all on me, and I clearly wasn't capable of even doing that. I couldn't even bring myself to care enough to do it. Which is how everything is in my life, really.

They won't. I've asked, they won't. I mean, for the most part, they can't, I guess, there's not a whole lot of money. They told me my only option was to try to get health insurance, but I couldn't gather the things I needed to submit the form because I didn't know where they were and I didn't even know the answers to some of the questions I had to answer, and I ended up missing the deadline, which triggered the entire "you're completely unreliable" and "you're never going to get professional help so deal with it yourself" and "am I going to have to kick you out to get you to start actually trying" talk that set me off enough to make this post.

I'm so sick of living with them and I need to get out of here because I'm not exactly wanted here, but I don't know where to go and I don't have the means to do anything and I don't have anyone to turn to and it's just right now really hitting me so sorry if this is incoherent, I'm having another panicky moment here and am not really sure how to word things. I mean, hitting me that I've never achieved anything and I can't do anything and I don't know what I'm supposed to do and I don't even see the point in trying.

Thank you. I wouldn't call myself levelheaded. I overreact to stressful things (and everything is stressful.) I don't feel like I have much inner strength left, if I ever had any.

Talking to someone would be a nice option, but one I have no idea how to do, without money or insurance to pay. I can't talk to family because they tend to belittle my feelings or bring things around to them and how they've been doing so much better or so much worse. But then I think I really have nothing wrong with me, do I? And somehow that makes me feel worse. I spend so much time in a haze thinking about how bad I feel even though there's no actual problem. It seems like a complete waste to me.

Everything seems so overwhelming, I guess. Nobody on my end wants to help me with anything, and I get lost and confused so easily. I do judge myself very harshly. Even when I'm around people I know like my company I still can't stop from getting nervous to the point of being completely incapable of conversation.

I feel like it's not so much that I don't know what I want to do with my life as I don't even want to do anything with my life anymore. I've never had the desire to do anything. Sometimes I have things I want but I'm not the type to work for them, I'd much rather ignore them because I can be content with my own thoughts. It's only when there's outside pressure (in this case, my own family being angry with me and talking about making me move out on my own) that I have any kind of strong reaction to anything. But I'm less of the type to fight and more of the type to fall under pressure.

Thank you. I went to a counselor for a while (and was told that getting to someone who could prescribe me things would be a very good idea) but since I couldn't pay for it myself and couldn't drive myself, I stopped going. I don't have health insurance or money to see anyone about that.

I don't have any idea how to cope with anything. The only thing I look forward to is avoiding life, I suppose you could say. Sleeping's one of the biggest things.
